output.answer: IBM is one of the tech industry's most acquisitive companies, with dozens of acquisitions on record since 2001 alone. Its most recent deal is the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy, announced September 24, 2026. Before that in 2026, IBM completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories (announced July 23, 2026) to bolster its quantum computing program, and closed its roughly $11 billion acquisition of data-streaming platform Confluent on March 17, 2026. In 2025 IBM bought Hakkoda (April) and closed the $6.4 billion HashiCorp deal (February 27) while announcing intents to acquire DataStax and Applications Software Technology; in 2024 it closed StreamSets and webMethods from Software AG and acquired Accelalpha, Kubecost, Prescinto, SiXworks and Skyarch Networks. Landmark earlier deals include Red Hat ($34 billion, 2019) and Apptio ($4.6 billion, 2023).
caveats: Financial terms were not disclosed for most IBM deals; the recent deals with published values are Confluent (~$11 billion), HashiCorp ($6.4 billion), Apptio ($4.6 billion) and Red Hat ($34 billion).

IBM has made well over 100 acquisitions across its history; this answer emphasizes the recent deals (2023-2026) disclosed on IBM's official M&A newsroom, and the newsroom list continues across multiple pages.
IBM announced intent to acquire DataStax in February 2025 and Applications Software Technology in January 2025; the corpus confirms the announcements but not the completion dates of those two deals.

output.question: What acquisitions has IBM made?

key_facts.fact: IBM acquired Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy serving defence, critical national infrastructure and the public sector.
key_facts.source_url: **London UK, September 24, 2026,** — IBM (NYSE: [IBM](http://www.ibm.com/investor)) UK today announced the acquisition of Logiq Consulting, an NCSC-assured UK cybersecurity consultancy with deep expertise in highly regulated environments including the UK Defence Industry, UK Critical National Infrastructure and the wider Public Sector.

key_facts.fact: IBM completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories, LLC, an R&D institution spanning quantum computing, quantum sensing, communications, electronics and materials science; announced July 23, 2026. Former owners Boeing and General Motors will continue partnering with IBM and HRL.
key_facts.source_url: **ARMONK, N.Y., Aug. 26, 2026 —** IBM (NYSE: [IBM](http://www.ibm.com/investor)) today announced it has completed its acquisition of HRL Laboratories, LLC (HRL), a leading research and development institution whose expertise spans quantum computing, quantum sensing, advanced communications, electronics, manufacturing, and materials science.

key_facts.fact: IBM completed its acquisition of Confluent, Inc., a data streaming platform used by more than 6,500 enterprises including 40% of the Fortune 500, for $31 per share in cash — an enterprise value of approximately $11 billion. The deal was announced December 8, 2025.
key_facts.source_url: Under the terms of the agreement, IBM has acquired all of the issued and outstanding common shares of Confluent for $31 per share in cash, representing an enterprise value of approximately $11 billion.

key_facts.fact: IBM acquired Hakkoda Inc., a data consultancy, to expand data expertise for clients' AI transformations.
key_facts.source_url: https://newsroom.ibm.com/mergers-and-acquisitions?item=33786[IBM Acquires Hakkoda Inc., Expanding Data Expertise to Fuel Clients' AI Transformations](https://newsroom.ibm.com/2025-04-07-ibm-acquires-hakkoda-inc-,-expanding-data-expertise-to-fuel-clients-ai-transformations)

key_facts.fact: IBM completed its acquisition of HashiCorp, whose products automate and secure hybrid cloud infrastructure; announced April 24, 2024 at $35 per share in cash, an enterprise value of $6.4 billion.
key_facts.source_url: ARMONK, N.Y., Feb. 27, 2025 /[PRNewswire](http://www.prnewswire.com/)/ -- IBM (NYSE: [IBM](http://www.ibm.com/investor)) today announced it has completed its acquisition of [HashiCorp](https://www.hashicorp.com/), whose products automate and secure the infrastructure that underpins hybrid cloud applications and generative AI. Together the companies' capabilities will help clients accelerate innovation, strengthen security, and get more value from the cloud.

key_facts.fact: IBM announced its intent to acquire DataStax, an AI and data solution provider, to enhance the watsonx portfolio for generative AI.
key_facts.source_url: IBM today is announcing its intent to acquire DataStax, an AI and data solution provider. DataStax's technology will enhance IBM's watsonx portfolio of products accelerating the use of generative AI, helping companies unlock value from vast amounts of unstructured data.

key_facts.fact: IBM announced its intent to acquire Applications Software Technology LLC to bolster Oracle expertise.
key_facts.source_url: https://newsroom.ibm.com/mergers-and-acquisitions?item=33783[IBM to Acquire Applications Software Technology LLC, Bolstering Oracle Expertise to Help Clients Transform Their Operations](https://newsroom.ibm.com/2025-01-16-ibm-to-acquire-application-software-technology-llc,-bolstering-oracle-expertise-to-help-clients-transform-their-operations)

key_facts.fact: IBM announced its intent to acquire Accelalpha, a global Oracle services provider; in 2024 IBM also acquired Kubecost (hybrid cloud cost management), Prescinto (renewables asset performance management), SiXworks (UK defence consultancy) and announced the acquisition of Skyarch Networks (AWS consulting in Japan).
key_facts.source_url: IBM announced its intent to acquire Accelalpha, a global Oracle services provider with deep expertise helping clients digitize core business operations and accelerate adoption of Oracle Cloud Applications.

key_facts.fact: IBM acquired Apptio, a SaaS provider of financial and operational insights across enterprise IT, for $4.6 billion.
IBM's largest acquisition to date was Red Hat, provider of open source software and solutions, for $34 billion.
